benchmark: Cold-process cProfile measurement of audit_replay on the same preserved 120-request root.

measurement_script.source:
import cProfile,hashlib,json,pstats,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
from agent_memory_eval.runner.decision_replay import audit_replay
from agent_memory_eval.contracts.core import canonical
label=sys.argv[1];out=Path('outputs/performance/20261116-schema-cache')
profile=cProfile.Profile();start=time.perf_counter();profile.enable();audit=audit_replay(Path('runs/tau2-decision-replay-luna-120-01'));profile.disable();elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
rows=[(key,value) for key,value in pstats.Stats(profile).stats.items() if key[2]=='validators' and key[0].endswith('contracts/validation.py')]
assert len(rows)==1
v=dict(label=label,wall_seconds=elapsed,audit_sha256=hashlib.sha256(canonical(audit)).hexdigest(),raw_log_sha256=audit['log_sha256'],responses=audit['counts'],reported_cost_usd=audit['reported_cost_usd_decimal'],validation_source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path('src/agent_memory_eval/contracts/validation.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),validators_calls=rows[0][1][1],validators_cumulative_seconds=rows[0][1][3],model_calls=0,profiling_enabled=True)
with (out/(label+'.json')).open('x') as stream:json.dump(v,stream,indent=2);stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(v))

limits: One measured execution per version; descriptive timing on this machine, not a statistical benchmark.
Profiling enabled for both executions; includes full stored-result audit and not a model request.
Writer blob verification and journal reparsing remain separate pending bottlenecks.
